description: SOP-001 §5.9 describes clearing the case number mid-count and a confirmation dialog, a flow that never existed

edits.find:
**The case number cannot be edited mid-count.** The field exists only on the
case-entry screen; during counting the case is shown as a read-only badge. There
is no change-the-case-number dialog — to correct a mistyped accession number,
finish or **Reset** the count and start again.
edits.replace:
**Method 1a: Change the case number mid-count.** Clear the current case number
in the case field; a confirmation dialog will appear. Confirm to continue the
count under the new case number.
